# messq_auth_hash

See `messq help exit-codes` for the exit-code contract.

## messq auth hash

hash a credential from stdin into the auth-file form

### Synopsis

Read ONE credential from stdin and print the SHA-256 hex form an auth-file
line carries. Hashes cover the WHOLE presented string including the msq1_
prefix and the id — there is no second parse of a credential anywhere in
messq. Newline rule: exactly one trailing LF (and one CR if CRLF) is
stripped; everything else hashes byte-for-byte. That means `echo $cred`
(which appends a newline) hashes DIFFERENTLY from `printf '%s' $cred`;
tests pin both digests so scripts can rely on either stated recipe.

```
messq auth hash [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  printf '%s' "$MESSQ_TOKEN" | messq auth hash # noexec: shell pipeline
  messq auth hash < token-copy.txt   # noexec: shell stdin redirection (one trailing newline tolerated)
```
